blocks.orig: Halisi Natron Camp is located on the southern shore of Lake Natron in a remote, private area – a birder’s paradise! The camp offers 10 spacious walk-in tents for single, double, triple or family occupancy. The tents are furnished with traditional East African décor, king-size beds with comfortable mattresses, and private en suite bathrooms with a bush shower, sink, and toilet. The camp has a lounge, dining and bar tent, and you can enjoy a campfire under the stars in the evenings. All food is sourced locally, which supports the economy and creates jobs and educational opportunities to empower members of the local villages. The camp utilizes solar energy, and minimal water usage, and measures designed to ensure the smallest carbon footprint possible, without compromising on service and comfort.
blocks.html: On the southern shore of Lake Natron, in a remote and private area, lies Halisi Natron Camp – a paradise for anyone who loves birds! The camp has 10 roomy walk-in tents suitable for one, two, three people or a family. Each tent is decorated in traditional East African style, with king-size beds, comfortable mattresses and a private en suite bathroom with a bush shower, sink and toilet. There is a lounge, dining and bar tent, and in the evening you can sit by a campfire under the stars. All the food comes from the local area, which supports the economy and provides jobs and education that empower people in the nearby villages. The camp runs on solar energy, keeps water use to a minimum and takes measures to keep its carbon footprint as small as possible, without giving up service or comfort.
